verses.1: A song for the children of Korah, to be sung in honor of those who suffer from illnesses. It’s a song for those who are wise and capable of understanding the world around them.
verses.2: YHWH, my God of salvation! On that night when I cried out to you.
verses.3: My prayers will come before you; please listen to my supplications.
verses.4: For my soul and my life are in the hands of those who are evil.
verses.5: I was considered one of those who lived on the banks of the river. I was like a drunkard without any sense of shame.
verses.6: In the dead, they lie like fugitives; their bodies are forgotten by those who remember them no longer. They have been taken away from you by your own hands.
verses.7: Be broken in the depths of darkness, under the weight of suffering and despair.
verses.8: On my shoulders, your heat has been applied; and all your wounds have been healed.
verses.9: You have strayed from my knowledge. I am subjected to many hardships, and I cannot escape them.
verses.10: My eyes are filled with sorrow because of you, O Lord. Every day I cry out to you, as my hands tremble.
verses.11: The healing will be complete if the doctors come and treat you.
verses.12: Your kindness has been recorded in the house of your grace; your mercy has come upon those who die.
verses.13: May I know your righteousness in darkness, and your truth in the land of women.
verses.14: And I will come to you, O LORD, in the evening; then I will pray and advance before you.
verses.15: Why, LORD, do you abandon my soul? Why hide your face from me?
verses.16: I am poor and suffering from hunger. I have carried your words on my shoulders.
verses.17: Your thorns have passed over me in your flight; they have pierced me.
verses.18: My ancestors were like water; they surrounded me all day long.
verses.19: You have gone far away from me, both lover and enemy of my heart.
